title: Sarwar Ne Kaha Apna Ghar baar luta dunga
body:
SARWAR NE KAHA APNA GHAR BAAR LUTAA DUNGA.
ISLAM TERI QAATIR..**2.
QOO'N APNA BAHAA DUNGA.
1. MAAREGA AGAR ZALIM, NAAWAK TERI GARDAN PAR.
JHOOLE SE UTHAKAR MAIN..***2
ASGHAR ASWS. KA GALAA DUNGA.
<<DIVIDER>>
2. BAAZU PE TERE AAYI, GAR KOI MUSEEBAT BHI.
WALLAAH BACHALUNGA...**2.
BAAZU E WAFA DOONGA.
<<DIVIDER>>
3. PYASA NA RAHEGA TU AY DEEN MERE REHTE.
PAANI KE EWAZ APNA..*2.
MAIN QOON PILAA DOONGA.
<<DIVIDER>>
4. HOGI JO ZARURAT TO AKBAR ASWS. KA BHI SEENA MAI.
BARCHI KE LIYE TERE..**2.
AAGE MAI BADHAA DOONGA.
<<DIVIDER>>
5. BE PARDA AGAR HOGA DARBAR MEIN ZALIM KE.
PARDE KE LIYE TUJHKO...**2.
ZAINAB ASWS. KI RIDA DOONGA.
<<DIVIDER>>
6. TUJHPE HO AGAR QATRA BAAZAR MEIN KUFE KE.
QUR'AAAN KATE SAR SE ...**2.
DUNIYA KO SUNAA DOONGA.
<<DIVIDER>>
7. ABID NE KAHA BABA DARBAR MEIN ZALIM KE.
QUTBO'N SE TERA MAQSAD...**2.
JO HAI WO BATAA DOONGA.
Kalaam: JANAB SYED MOHEBBE ABID ABIDI SAHAB QIBLA.
